heading: Privacy Policy

bullets: No tracking cookies or analytics: We do not set marketing cookies or run behavioral tracking scripts (such as Google Analytics). Standard ephemeral HTTP request logs are recorded by Cloudflare at the edge solely for network security and CDN caching (see §3).
No user profiling or telemetry: We do not record keystrokes, reading activity, or session replays.

No account required: You do not need to register or log in to read, gloss, or export texts. An optional administrative login is available only for project maintainers committing changes to the canonical repository.
privacySections.title: Information We Do Not Collect

bullets: Local Draft Envelopes: Working document drafts and editing snapshots stored in canonical schema format.
Uncommitted Draft Index: Local manifest index tracking uncommitted draft changes.
Active Document Selection: Remembers your last active text selection in the reader.
privacySections.content: To ensure your work is preserved across page reloads and available offline, Glossy stores draft documents and user preferences locally in your web browser:
privacySections.title: Browser Storage (localStorage)

bullets: Standard HTTP request logs include ephemeral IP address, request time, user-agent, and requested resource path.
Edge access logs are ephemeral and are not linked to individual user profiles or reading activity.
privacySections.content: Glossy is hosted via Cloudflare Pages as a static application (Next.js static export). Server request logs are standard HTTP request logs processed by Cloudflare at the edge for DDoS protection, security, and CDN caching.
privacySections.title: Static Hosting & Edge Delivery

bullets: One-click LaTeX gb4e export produces self-contained academic TeX files.
Local drafts can be deleted individually from the home corpus directory.
privacySections.content: You maintain complete ownership and control over any text you ingest or gloss in Glossy. You can export your full gloss data at any time via LaTeX gb4e, JSON, or CSV, or wipe all browser-stored drafts by clearing your browser's site data.
privacySections.title: Open Source Code & Data Portability
